title: The United States Act of 1871 Explained
summary: Narrated timeline claiming the US is a private corporation run by a banking cartel: the Fed, a 1925 'United States Corporation Company', a private IRS, and statutes as corporate rules.

assertions.quote: the federal and state governments are not real they are privately owned corporations called governments
the Federal Reserve is a private corporation therefore their notes are privately owned currency

verdicts.note: Regional reserve banks have member-bank stockholders, but the Fed is a government-created system and its notes are obligations of the United States.

assertions.quote: the Internal Revenue Service was chartered in Delaware as a private corporation it is not a division of the US Treasury

verdicts.note: The IRS is a bureau of the Treasury under 26 USC 7801-7803; courts reject the Delaware-charter claim.

The IRS is an agency created under the Treasury Secretary's IRC 7801 authority with a Commissioner under 7803; the 11th Circuit held it is clearly an agency of the United States and courts call the private-corporation claim wholly frivolous.

assertions.quote: the people in the property of the United States was hypothecated and placed unlawfully in a public trust
a corporate statute is a rule of a corporation given the force of law by the consent of the parties
the u.s. CEO the president has maintained unconstitutional emergency powers for the past 80 years

verdicts.note: The 1976 National Emergencies Act ended the old emergencies; current emergencies are specific, statutory and reviewable.
